literature_notes: All six ledger lines (L1–L6) describe the same chimeric IL15RB construct from PMC11472742. The construct architecture is: IL-15 — c-myc tag (EQKLISEEDL) — IL2Rα extracellular shaft (EMETSQFPGEEKPQASPEGRPESETSC) — IL2Rβ mature protein (residues 27–551). The c-myc tag is positioned between IL-15 and the IL2Rα shaft, not at or within IL2Rβ's extracellular domain. IL2Rβ's own sequence is intact from the mature N-terminus (residue 27, A) onward; it functions as the transmembrane anchor of the chimera. No ledger line reports a tag insertion at a specific IL2Rβ residue, in any IL2Rβ extracellular loop, or at IL2Rβ's N-terminus (the IL2Rα shaft, not a tag, is fused there). The construct also does not qualify as a 'topology_derived' N-terminal tag on IL2Rβ because the c-myc tag is separated from IL2Rβ's N-terminus by the entire 27-aa IL2Rα shaft — the tag is in the chimeric extension, not on IL2Rβ's surface. Under the ledger rules, zero sites qualify.
